item.title: 【Singles (lossy)】M4A - Madonna - Future (Madame X Tour Backing Track) [iTunes Rip AAC M4A]
item.description:
Artists: Madonna & Quavo
Song: Future (Madame X Tour: Backing Track)
Format: iTunes Rip AAC M4A

NOTE: This is the version used during the Madame X Tour shows. It is a backing track designed to support live vocals, which is why Madonna's voice is quieter at times. This audio was taken from the live album Madame X – Music from the Theatre Xperience.
